CustomField.description: The date the term recorded by this submission began. Set this on import so historical terms carry their real date rather than the date they were loaded. Reporting groups on this field, not CreatedDate, so backfills do not require the Set Audit Fields org permission.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date this membership term started. On imported history, set this to the original transaction date.
CustomField.label: Term Start Date
